data_fields.name: armour_fraction_constant
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.1 x armour / (8.5 x level + 40), then x / (1 + x)

data_fields.name: bleed_tick_armour_exempt
data_fields.donor_constant: true for periodic bleed ticks; false for direct hits

data_fields.name: finisher_bleed_crit_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: amount of caster dummy aura 2859 effect 1 (database value, not read)

best_idea: A bleed tick skips armour while a direct physical hit does not, so bleeding counters heavy armour, and a finisher gets a bonus crit against a bleeding target.
decision_why: The bleed-ignores-armour rule is clear and testable and links a wound to a finisher, but Frankendom has no armour model or level term to copy WoW's formula onto; take the rule and the data flags, not the formula.
acceptance: Server test with armour 500 and attacker level 60: a 100-damage physical direct hit lands at 93 and the same 100 as a bleed tick lands at 100; a catalogue-flagged finisher gets its bonus crit only against a bleeding target; the client tint follows the server bleed state only.
